V01.name: Attribute binding and set logic
V01.description: Find objects that satisfy several visible properties at once.

V02.name: Conditional counting
V02.description: Count only the objects meeting the stated visual rule.

V03.name: Spatial relationships
V03.description: Apply left/right, above/below or relative-position constraints.

V04.name: Connectivity and reachability
V04.description: Follow connected paths or directed arrows between nodes.

V05.name: Navigation and planning
V05.description: Choose a feasible route under movement and obstacle rules.

V06.name: Rotation and reflection
V06.description: Recognize the result of a rotation or mirror transformation.

V07.name: Geometry, folding and fit
V07.description: Reason about shapes, folds, dimensions or what fits.

V08.name: Visual rule application
V08.description: Infer or apply a rule across symbols and pictured patterns.

V09.name: Sequential state tracking
V09.description: Track how successive visible actions change a state.

V10.name: Constraint satisfaction
V10.description: Find the arrangement satisfying all the stated restrictions.

V11.name: Flowcharts and decision trees
V11.description: Follow conditional branches to their final outcome.

V12.name: Causal and counterfactual reasoning
V12.description: Determine what changes when a pictured condition is altered.

V13.name: Charts and quantitative comparisons
V13.description: Read plotted values and compare or calculate the required quantity.

V14.name: Document reconciliation
V14.description: Combine entries across forms, receipts or tables and apply a rule.

V15.name: Interface state decisions
V15.description: Choose an action or identify a state from a screenshot.

V16.name: Inspection against a reference
V16.description: Compare an object or scene against a supplied reference.

V17.name: Matching across images
V17.description: Identify a corresponding object across two or three images.

V18.name: Image and text consistency
V18.description: Check whether a written claim agrees with the visible evidence.

V19.name: Perspective and knowledge tracking
V19.description: Apply line-of-sight constraints or track what an observer has seen.

V20.name: Insufficient evidence
V20.description: Recognize when the image cannot determine the requested answer.

Confidence thresholds explored after observing these results; not deployment calibration.
